title: Karachi To Dhabeji For Railfanning & Visiting Bhanbore | Full Day Spent For Love of Trains
description: Hello Everyone, Today's vlog is a comprehensive one.. a bit long but trust me worth every second. Today's video is in collaboration with @SitesandSounds Faheem Bhai, we both visit Dhabeji from Karachi on KCR train and spent full day there watching trains and also exploring one of an archaeological sites of Pakistan, named Bhanbore Ruins & Museum which is located 7-8 kilometers from Dhabeji Railway Station. Dhabeji is located some 60 kilometers from Karachi and is accessible both my road and railways. Administratively, it is part of Thatta District. Since Dhabeji is a high speed zone, most trains pass from here with 100+ kmph speed. This was the main reason to go there for railfanning. Hope you will enjoy today's comprehensive vlog which not only include rail journey but also cab ride, train spotting, visiting an archaeological site, street food etc. Do tell in feedback what you think of such video where whole day is spent railfanning.. Thanks   Date: 18th March 2021   Music by @tellyourstorymusicbyikson

asr.full_text: Assalamualaikum Railfanning is a great hobby And along with completing this hobby, you also get chance to see new places One day I spent with a friend of mine when we went from Karachi to Dhabi Railway Station for railfanning and spent whole day doing this hobby Dhabeji is a city of District Thatta of Sindh province which I will tell you more about Today with me is the one who makes Pakistan's most awesome railfan videos, Faheem Bhai You must have known him from Sights and Sounds YouTube channel Faheem Bhai is from Islamabad but he was present in Karachi therefore we decided to name it Railfanning one day This happened on 18th March 2021 When me and Faheem bhai reached Malheer Colony of Karachi at 7 AM Its old name was this station was Malir Halt but now it is known as Malir Colony Apart from this station, there is no stop of any other railway station of Karachi circular railway train and we had to travel to Dhabe on this station For Mirpur, another train used to stop here But it is closed now after lock down This station had good morning flowers Because KCR-1UP train arrived, little time left So had tea from nearby dhaba which is very important in morning At about 7.48pm, KCR-2DN reached which reaches Aurangi station from Dhaba Now we have to take right turn Before it left, a trespassing girl fell down We are now in 4DN KCI Before departing, even a trespasser girl fell but is lucky since train was stopped then After a little stop, train moved ahead So... By the end, at 8PM, Karachi SRA1 reached Malheer Colony Railway Station From where we had to board & clear travel to Dhabeji Press passing is going on And our favorite locomotive It's going on! The rest passing is also going on And our favorite locomotive BMW 4711 is owing After Malir Colony, next station is Malir where while reaching it faced 32DN Jinnah Express After Malir station, Malir river bridge was passed which is first big bridge of Karachi Next station is Landhi Railway Station where we faced 26DN Bahauddin Zikriya Express On its lead today was GEU-40 locomotive Just before landing was Juma Goat on siding line, there was a dark colored GMU-30 locomotive was standing with freight train We had to do our duty After Jumma Goat, we came to Bin Qasim station and freight wagons were present on loop line there Because of which KCR had to stop at main line After Bin Qasim, next stop was at Badar Nala's Chhote station where I had done railfan back few days before After Badal Nala, we stopped at Marshalling Yard Pipri and Marshalling Yard Colony Halt where most of railway traffic came down Before Dabegi, last stop was Gadar station where I have already presented detailed railfanning vlog for you Next stop was Dhabeji and few moments before line And at that time 150DN Mehran Express also reached down Mehran Express After getting down, we reached at KCR's GMU-30 locomotive in KCR after departure where it was to be detached & reach Peppery & return in evening when KCR rake had to remain here While decoupling of locomotive was decoupling a freight train passed from up track On its lead, there was blue MLC locomotive's detachment, when it was transferring on down line then locomotive pilot Zahid told about key man's role that till engine changes lane through manual point at station's limit till then all auto outer and home signals remain red Finally we left for Pipri in 4711 LHF mode and we had to stay here till evening Before doing railfanning, let's know about Dhabeji station This small railway station was built in 1861 in British era This station is located on mainline 1 at 60 km marker This is the first station on mainline outside of Karachi And is part of Thatta district in terms of arrangement Nowadays here is only stop of Karachi circular railway Let me tell you one more interesting thing about this station that it was the famous train station in our TV drama Mushk which was shown in drama as Bin Adam Dhabeji is a high speed zone and mostly trains pass here at more than 100 kmph Here on up track, we saw another freight train with lead on it which was GEU-40 locomotive Soon after, 18DN Millat Express also appeared I was about to pass, I was about to pass Next stop was 8DN Tezgam which passed when it raged with ZCU-30 locomotive Almost 110 kmph Now saw a freight train on track which passed at very high speed with NLC locomotive But it passed in very slow speed So its passing is being shown in fast forward It was a very hot day I was very hungry So I had breakfast with dry parathas from a dhaba hotel outside the station Such hotels use oil with open heart Two omelets Anyhow breakfast was tasty Or might have been for hungry people After breakfast, we returned back and to capture next action, we reached at Dhabeji, station returned and to capture next action reached Dhabeji bridge quite far away from station The first train captured at Dhabeji bridge was 47UP Reherman Baba Express that came through with HGMU-30 locomotive On this bridge, 34DN Park Business Express was also captured whose lead was AG-30 locomotive After the afternoon, heat was increasing Washed hands and fresh hands and went to next destination and now our turn was to Bambor Bambor is an archaeological site where ancient monuments of old cities are found Distance from Dabeji Station to here is only 8-9 km and you can reach here easily by rickshaw you can easily get on rickshaw Actually we have paid 500 rupees for rickshaw It is said that Bambori was known as Debal in old timid city of Sindh And Mohammed bin Qasim had entered Sindh from here then conquered it Here is a wonderful museum too where things that were returned after conquering were used for transportation Outside this museum, the Monastery of Manjunik is also inside which was used as building barrier barrier to break strong walls of fort Apart from this, a bit near we can also see ruins of Asare Kadima Where a damaged city is still in present For people's recreation, boards were also placed Here is the oldest mosque of West Asia On other side of these ruins, Gharo creek also passes Here you can be seen sea breeze During this summer, after exploring all these had juice from the canteen there after drinking them then refreshing This canteen was newly made for passengers and it is very good and clean Here is government guest house too is available and for $4 ,000 the good rooms are available at rent Well After detailed visit of Bhuman board, we returned towards Dhabeji station On way too we captured 16DN Karachi Express on way At next station, next train reached here And that was 6DN Greenline which passed at great speed There are many like them on the road. A few moments later on up track also 45UP Pakistan Express reached And passed with SGMU-30 locomotive Then go on Now next train was 48DN Rehman Baba Express But its speed was somewhat lower then 100 There was no one outside At 2.42 am, KCR's GMU-30 was also arrived from KCR and was coupled with the track and then it was sent on a down side loop line Now the next train was 9UP Alam-e-Ikbal Express which passed by with GEU-20 locomotive After 9UP next train will was 31UP Jinnah Express which passed with great track sounds via GR-40 locomotive This is my last train The next train was 41UP Karakoram Express That passed with GEU-40 locomotive 44DN Shah Hussain Express delayed KCR-4DN and was stopped at loop line Finally at 4.47pm, 44DN AG-30 was passed with locomotives After Shah Hussain Express passed, at 4.50 PM, KCR was placed on Dhabeji in GMU's cab And as soon as I saw green signal, I departed from KCR Dhabeji after crossing Tabiaji Where are you going? On uptrack near Gengar Bridge, we also Amna from 149UP Mehran Express Near 44km marker, we also met Amna from 149UP Mehran Express 149UP Mehran Express also faced Amna 149UP Mehran Express At 5.35PM, stopped at Jummah Ghot and then reached Landhi at 5.44PM Where 17UP Millat Express faced us We are very tired from Landhi station, came Malir bridge And stopped at Malir, our last stop was Malir Colony Station Where we landed, thanking lo local pilot and assistant local pilot and got down and KCR departed for ahead After a long day of railfanning, we reached our end Today where we saw so many trains there we also got a chance to see our ancestors too Hope you have enjoyed today's vlog InshaALLAH will see you soon with next vlog Allah Hafiz

segments.text: Assalamualaikum
Railfanning is a great hobby
And along with completing this hobby, you also get chance to see new places
One day I spent with a friend of mine
when we went from Karachi to Dhabi Railway Station for railfanning
and spent whole day doing this hobby
Dhabeji is a city of District Thatta of Sindh province
which I will tell you more about
Today with me is the one who makes Pakistan's most awesome railfan videos, Faheem Bhai
You must have known him from Sights and Sounds YouTube channel
Faheem Bhai is from Islamabad
but he was present in Karachi
therefore we decided to name it Railfanning one day
This happened on 18th March 2021
When me and Faheem bhai reached Malheer Colony of Karachi at 7 AM
Its old name was this station was Malir Halt
but now it is known as Malir Colony
Apart from this station, there is no stop of any other railway station of Karachi circular railway train
and we had to travel to Dhabe on this station
For Mirpur, another train used to stop here
But it is closed now after lock down
This station had good morning flowers
Because KCR-1UP train arrived, little time left
So had tea from nearby dhaba
which is very important in morning
At about 7.48pm, KCR-2DN reached
which reaches Aurangi station from Dhaba Now we have to take right turn Before it left, a trespassing girl fell down We are now in 4DN KCI
Before departing, even a trespasser girl fell
but is lucky since train was stopped then
After a little stop, train moved ahead So... By the end, at 8PM, Karachi SRA1 reached Malheer Colony Railway Station
From where we had to board & clear travel to Dhabeji
Press passing is going on
And our favorite locomotive It's going on! The rest passing is also going on
And our favorite locomotive
BMW 4711 is owing After Malir Colony, next station is Malir
where while reaching it faced 32DN Jinnah Express After Malir station, Malir river bridge was passed
which is first big bridge of Karachi Next station is Landhi Railway Station
where we faced 26DN Bahauddin Zikriya Express
On its lead today was GEU-40 locomotive Just before landing was Juma Goat
on siding line, there was a dark colored GMU-30 locomotive was standing with freight train We had to do our duty
After Jumma Goat, we came to Bin Qasim station
and freight wagons were present on loop line there

Because of which KCR had to stop at main line After Bin Qasim, next stop was at Badar Nala's Chhote station where I had done railfan back few days before After Badal Nala, we stopped at Marshalling Yard Pipri and Marshalling Yard Colony Halt
where most of railway traffic came down
Before Dabegi, last stop was Gadar station

where I have already presented detailed railfanning vlog for you Next stop was Dhabeji and few moments before line And at that time 150DN Mehran Express also reached down Mehran Express After getting down, we reached at KCR's GMU-30 locomotive in KCR after departure
where it was to be detached & reach Peppery
& return in evening
when KCR rake had to remain here
While decoupling of locomotive was decoupling
a freight train passed from up track
On its lead, there was blue MLC locomotive's detachment, when it was transferring on down line
then locomotive pilot Zahid told about key man's role
that till engine changes lane through manual point at station's limit
till then all auto outer and home signals remain red Finally we left for Pipri in 4711 LHF mode
and we had to stay here till evening
Before doing railfanning, let's know about Dhabeji station
This small railway station was built in 1861 in British era
This station is located on mainline 1 at 60 km marker
This is the first station on mainline outside of Karachi
And is part of Thatta district in terms of arrangement
Nowadays here is only stop of Karachi circular railway
Let me tell you one more interesting thing about this station
that it was the famous train station in our TV drama Mushk
which was shown in drama as Bin Adam
Dhabeji is a high speed zone
and mostly trains pass here at more than 100 kmph
Here on up track, we saw another freight train with lead on it which was GEU-40 locomotive Soon after, 18DN Millat Express also appeared I was about to pass, I was about to pass
Next stop was 8DN Tezgam
which passed when it raged with ZCU-30 locomotive Almost 110 kmph Now saw a freight train on track
which passed at very high speed with NLC locomotive
But it passed in very slow speed
So its passing is being shown in fast forward It was a very hot day
I was very hungry So I had breakfast with dry parathas from a dhaba hotel outside the station
Such hotels use oil with open heart Two omelets Anyhow breakfast was tasty
Or might have been for hungry people
After breakfast, we returned back
and to capture next action, we reached at Dhabeji, station returned and to capture next action
reached Dhabeji bridge quite far away from station
The first train captured at Dhabeji bridge
was 47UP Reherman Baba Express
that came through with HGMU-30 locomotive On this bridge, 34DN Park Business Express was also captured
whose lead was AG-30 locomotive After the afternoon, heat was increasing
Washed hands and fresh hands and went to next destination
and now our turn was to Bambor
Bambor is an archaeological site
where ancient monuments of old cities are found
Distance from Dabeji Station to here is only 8-9 km
and you can reach here easily by rickshaw you can easily get on rickshaw
Actually we have paid 500 rupees for rickshaw
It is said that Bambori was known as Debal in old timid city of Sindh
And Mohammed bin Qasim had entered Sindh from here
then conquered it
Here is a wonderful museum too
where things that were returned after conquering
were used for transportation Outside this museum, the Monastery of Manjunik is also inside
which was used as building barrier barrier to break strong walls of fort
Apart from this, a bit near we can also see ruins of Asare Kadima
Where a damaged city is still in present
For people's recreation, boards were also placed
Here is the oldest mosque of West Asia On other side of these ruins, Gharo creek also passes
Here you can be seen sea breeze
During this summer, after exploring all these
had juice from the canteen there
after drinking them then refreshing
This canteen was newly made for passengers
and it is very good and clean
Here is government guest house too is available and for $4 ,000 the good rooms are available at rent
Well
After detailed visit of Bhuman board, we returned towards Dhabeji station
On way too we captured 16DN Karachi Express on way At next station, next train reached here
And that was 6DN Greenline
which passed at great speed There are many like them on the road. A few moments later on up track also 45UP Pakistan Express reached
And passed with SGMU-30 locomotive Then go on
Now next train was 48DN Rehman Baba Express
But its speed was somewhat lower then 100 There was no one outside At 2.42 am, KCR's GMU-30 was also arrived from KCR
and was coupled with the track
and then it was sent on a down side loop line
Now the next train was 9UP Alam-e-Ikbal Express
which passed by with GEU-20 locomotive After 9UP next train will was 31UP Jinnah Express
which passed with great track sounds via GR-40 locomotive This is my last train
The next train was 41UP Karakoram Express
That passed with GEU-40 locomotive 44DN Shah Hussain Express delayed KCR-4DN
and was stopped at loop line
Finally at 4.47pm, 44DN AG-30 was passed with locomotives After Shah Hussain Express passed, at 4.50 PM, KCR was placed on Dhabeji in GMU's cab
And as soon as I saw green signal, I departed from KCR Dhabeji after crossing Tabiaji Where are you going?
On uptrack near Gengar Bridge, we also Amna from 149UP Mehran Express
Near 44km marker, we also met Amna from 149UP Mehran Express
149UP Mehran Express also faced Amna 149UP Mehran Express
At 5.35PM, stopped at Jummah Ghot
and then reached Landhi at 5.44PM
Where 17UP Millat Express faced us
We are very tired from Landhi station, came Malir bridge
And stopped at Malir, our last stop was Malir Colony Station
Where we landed, thanking lo local pilot and assistant local pilot and got down
and KCR departed for ahead After a long day of railfanning, we reached our end
Today where we saw so many trains
there we also got a chance to see our ancestors too
Hope you have enjoyed today's vlog
InshaALLAH will see you soon with next vlog
Allah Hafiz
